title: RNA-Seq ACSS2 Knockdown Analysis
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract cellular RNA using the RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog 74104) according to the kit’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Analyze RNA integrity and quantify the extracted RNA with an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Select input RNA amount
steps.instruction: Take 200 ng of the total RNA for downstream library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries using the NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit (New England Biolabs GmbH, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Evaluate library quality
steps.instruction: Measure the quantity and quality of the prepared libraries with an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument and sequence to obtain approximately 35 million paired‑end reads per library, each 100 bp in length.
